expectations.text: Recommends against adopting the event app for this edition instead of planning its rollout.
expectations.evidence: "❌ Do not buy the EventPulse app ($4,800)."

expectations.text: States the announcement list reaches every registrant by construction while an app reaches only the subset who install it.
expectations.evidence: "Push reaches only people who installed the app... The email list reaches every registrant by construction."

expectations.text: Rejects the vendor's 80% install figure, stating no adoption figure exists for community-run events and a vendor's number is not to be accepted.
expectations.evidence: "No adoption figure exists for community-run technical events, so don't accept the vendor's."

expectations.text: Names the app's promotion conditions - a signed commitment forcing one, three or more concurrent rooms with a schedule grid changing more than once a day, or an already-owned app with sunk content cost - and finds none applies here.
expectations.evidence: Lists signed commitment, 3+ rooms with grid changing more than once a day, owned app; "You have none of these."

expectations.text: States the app tops the effort ordering (setup plus standing operations) while losing to the announcement list on reach, so the efficiency ordering never selects it.
expectations.evidence: Only says app ranks "last on efficiency" and adds "standing work"; no effort-ordering vs reach statement.

expectations.text: Names the announcement list as the default floor channel for a one-day, two-room, locked-schedule event.
expectations.evidence: "Use the registration email list plus on-site announcements."

expectations.text: Lists or asks for the message classes the edition will actually send before fixing any channel roster.
expectations.evidence: Roster is section 2; routing/message classes come in section 3.

expectations.text: If a push-speed channel is judged necessary at all, proposes the chat space over the app, since chat matches the app on speed at lower effort.
expectations.evidence: "the cheaper fix is a broadcast-only chat channel... not an app."

expectations.text: Asks whether anything signed (sponsor deliverable, venue system, umbrella platform) forces a channel before closing the decision.
expectations.evidence: Assumes "No contract forces an app"; not among the six open questions.

expectations.text: Asks about the effort ceiling - organizer hours before the event and who can watch each channel during it - before adding any channel beyond the list.
expectations.evidence: Q4 asks writers and week-after duty, not organizer hours or watchers per channel.

expectations.text: Gives every channel retained one stated job and one named owner.
